memory_bridge: Let the knife divide a day-planner into four labeled slices: 自分 for On ブン points to oneself, 五分 for On フン measures five minutes, 分かる for Kun わかる is the moment a puzzle becomes understood, and 分ける for Kun わける physically divides the pieces. The cutting image organizes them without collapsing their distinct senses.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 自分（じぶん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Hand one of the eight cut pieces to yourself and label it 自分（じぶん）; the final character uses On ブン in “myself.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 五分（ごふん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Set the knife-timer to 五分（ごふん）, “five minutes”; the counter reading of the final character is On フン.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 分かる（わかる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Fit the divided puzzle pieces together until the answer clicks and you 分かる（わかる）; the complete native verb fixes Kun わかる, “to understand.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 分ける（わける）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Use the knife to sort the pieces into separate bowls and 分ける（わける）; the complete transitive verb fixes Kun わける, “to divide.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 理由（りゆう）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The traveler returns the jade and writes the 理由（りゆう）—reason—for the trip. The exact common word anchors On リ without depending on an English L/R approximation.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 已经 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: A timeline thread held straight in the warp shows the clock has 已经（yǐ jīng）, “already,” reached its mark; keep jīng high and level along the taut thread.
